title: Responder Brief Pane — Cost-aware Reroute & Postmortem Shortcuts (Prototype)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact in-console 'Responder Brief Pane' that surfaces the minimal context an on-call responder needs for first-touch triage: SLO deltas, recent error traces, a concise runbook snippet, and cost-aware reroute suggestions for routing traffic off high-cost variants during incidents. The pane should include one-click actions to: open a pre-filled postmortem link (Confluence), create a GitHub incident PR template, and capture a short shift-summary that can be attached to the incident. The prototype emphasizes minimal cognitive load, preserving screen real estate in the Alerts timeline while allowing rapid decisioning.
design_notes: Initial exploration focused on three orientations: a right-side compact flyout, an inline collapsible strip in the alert timeline, and a transient modal. Usability tests (n=6 engineers) favored the inline collapsible strip for speed of access and context retention. Key patterns: (1) compact SLO sparkline + percent delta, (2) 'cost nudge' badge when current model/route is above configured cost threshold, (3) quick toggles for anonymized logs (GDPR) and 'mute reroutes' for scheduled maintenance. Prototype built in Figma with tokenized components to match Console theme.
acceptance_criteria: Responder Brief Pane appears collapsed by default inside the alert timeline and expands with keyboard or click
Displays current SLO status with delta and a tooltip explaining calculation window
Shows top 3 recent error traces with direct links to full trace view
Cost-aware reroute recommendation appears when cost delta > configured threshold with a suggested target and estimated monthly savings
One-click 'Create Postmortem' opens Confluence template prefilled with alert metadata and attaches responder summary
Telemetry hooks defined: brief_open, reroute_suggested, reroute_confirmed, postmortem_created
Design tokens and responsive behavior validated against mobile/desktop breakpoints

open_questions: What is the canonical window for SLO delta calculation (5m/15m/1h)?
Should cost-aware reroutes be allowed by default for enterprise customers or gated behind a policy?
How do we represent uncertainty in savings estimates to avoid misleading customers?
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: 'Cost nudge' could cause noisy suggestions and lead to unnecessary route churn. Mitigation: add configurable threshold and require 2x SLO impact before auto-suggest.
Risk: Postmortem shortcut may omit critical incident fields. Mitigation: prefill with metadata but require manual review before publishing.
Risk: PII leak in runbook snippets. Mitigation: default anonymized snippets and add visible toggle with confirmation.
